statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry)
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42)
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The claim was denied with reason code CO-50
The denial reason was that the service was not deemed medically necessary
